items.title: Heres what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
items.summary: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.

items.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll
items.summary: The September survey offered a possible window into US voters who could consider fintech and digital asset policies on Election Day.

items.title: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
items.summary: The blockchain-based fund offers eligible non-US investors exposure to the Nasdaq-100 as Janus Henderson expands its institutional tokenization business.

items.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
items.summary: USDCs share of euro stablecoin trading has climbed to 56% since January 2024, with deeper liquidity as exchanges restrict USDT under MiCA.

items.title: Crypto could outperform AI stocks: Wall Street veteran Jordi Visser
items.summary: Former Morgan Stanley and Weiss executive Jordi Visser says AI agents are boosting demand for crypto as he expands his holdings beyond Bitcoin, Ether and Solana.

items.title: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor
items.summary: An expanded deal with Bitso puts Anchorage Digital Banks custody beneath both sides of the US-Mexico remittance route.

items.title: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
items.summary: Akamai launched a locked box for AI agents on Tuesday as companies prepare for autonomous systems that can act without human oversight.

items.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM Join Objections to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue, Bringing Total to 26
items.summary: The tech giants joined banks and exchanges in objecting to a planned venue that would list tokenized stocks outside traditional market hours.

items.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
items.summary: Keystone said a compromised signing key allowed counterfeit devices into the supply chain and has pulled affected units.

items.title: Circle Pushes Deeper Into Latin America With USDC Settlement in Colombia
items.summary: Circle is expanding USDC settlement rails in Colombia as part of a broader push into Latin American payment corridors.

items.title: A $3M Hedge, a Midterm Test and Retail's Rise: Prediction Markets at NEXTPredict
items.summary: Chuck Todd called markets a fact checker for journalism, as Kalshi, Polymarket and Robinhood pitched contracts well beyond elections.

items.title: CFTC sues Utah as battle over prediction market regulation intensifies
items.summary: The CFTC is escalating its legal fight with states, suing Utah after the state filed a lawsuit against prediction market platform Kalshi.

items.title: Crypto.com and OG.com launch US crypto perps with up to 5x leverage
items.summary: The platforms are offering crypto perpetual futures to US users with leverage capped at 5x under the current regulatory setup.

items.title: Canton-based trading platform Cancore raises $7.2 million at $60 million token valuation
items.summary: Cancore, a Canton-based trading platform connecting assets on the network with liquidity on public blockchains, has raised $7.2 million in seed funding.

items.title: SoFi discloses 503,000 crypto products as gross crypto revenue hits $162 million
items.summary: SoFi broke out crypto products for the first time. Gross crypto revenue rose 20%, while total net revenue hit a record $1.39 billion.

items.title: Ripple, BNY explore using the XRP Ledger to finance approved invoices
items.summary: BNY adds XRP and RLUSD to its custody platform, as Ripple and C2FO test settling invoice payments on the XRP Ledger.

items.title: Galaxy Digital swings to $323 million quarterly profit, announces new $200 million share buyback
items.summary: Galaxy returned to profitability in the third quarter as trading volumes and lending increased, with a new $200 million buyback authorized.

items.title: Ripple gets final US trust bank approval. What does XRP gain?
items.summary: Ripple secured final approval for a US trust bank charter, potentially opening new pathways for RLUSD and XRP utility in institutional settlement.

items.title: Lightning tightens invoice rules after reported attack made Bitcoin withdrawals look unpaid
items.summary: BOLT11 now requires one payment hash and one payment secret, while operators must check how their software records withdrawals.

items.title: Iran-linked Bitcoin activity fell about 80%, then rebounded during the blackout
items.summary: On-chain data shows Iranian-linked Bitcoin flows dropped sharply during internet restrictions before recovering once connectivity returned.

items.title: Kraken opens Bitcoin and Ethereum options to eligible European traders
items.summary: The EEA rollout adds USD-settled contracts to existing derivatives accounts, with shared futures collateral and portfolio margin on by default.

items.title: Japans services inflation split complicates the BOJ outlook before Fridays decision
items.summary: Business-service inflation reached 3.7%, while the transport-excluded rate held steady and labor-sensitive price growth eased before Fridays BOJ decision.

items.title: Bitcoins next rally could trigger selling from holders of 874,000 BTC
items.summary: Bitfinex maps potential overhead supply as ETF inflows return through IBIT alone, leaving spot buyers to prove a durable reclaim.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Rests Near $80,500 as Midterms, Fed Decision Loom
items.summary: Bitcoin price recovered from an early-morning low near $79,400 to trade around $80,500 on Tuesday, holding above $80,000 ahead of this weeks Fed decision and the November midterms.

items.title: VanEck Launches All-in-One Wealth Builder ETF With Bitcoin Exposure
items.summary: VanEck launched a multi-asset ETF that includes Bitcoin exposure as part of a broader wealth-building allocation.

items.title: 27-Year-Old Missouri Man Admits Role in Failed Bitcoin Kidnapping Plot
items.summary: A Missouri man pleaded guilty to participating in a plot to kidnap a Bitcoin holder for ransom that was disrupted by law enforcement.

items.title: CFTC Again Probes Polymarket Over Whether It Let Americans Trade
items.summary: The CFTC is once again examining whether Polymarket allowed US persons to trade on its prediction markets in violation of prior agreements.

items.title: Next Weeks Midterms Could Stall the CLARITY Act and Test Cryptos Political Clout: TD Cowen
items.summary: TD Cowen analysts say the midterm elections could delay the CLARITY Act and serve as a test of the crypto industrys lobbying power.

items.title: Ten Decrees: Old Masters, New Money
items.summary: Lucho Poletti on redrawing Hieronymus Bosch and Pieter Bruegel the Elder around money, Nixons 1971 decree, and why bitcoin art keeps returning to the old masters.

items.title: U.S. agency hits Utah with lawsuit to shield Kalshi's ability to offer betting there
items.summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has pursued more than a dozen legal actions to protect what its chief sees as its sole power over prediction markets.

items.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM join growing list of firms objecting to OKXICE tokenized stock plans
items.summary: Major tech firms joined the list of objectors to a proposed tokenized stock trading venue involving OKX and ICE.

items.title: Brazilian companies turned to stablecoins on election day to dodge a currency crash
items.summary: USDT volume on crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin jumped nearly 800% and bitcoin volume surged 865%. Binances USDT/BRL market tripled while the global BTC/USDT pair fell.

items.title: Robinhood taps Ripples $2.5 billion RLUSD stablecoin despite backing rival USDG
items.summary: Robinhood is integrating Ripples RLUSD for certain settlement flows even while supporting a competing stablecoin product.

items.title: Nasdaq-100 comes onchain as Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launch first licensed fund
items.summary: The $500 billion asset manager is launching an issuer-sponsored fund on Stellar, taking a different approach from third-party stock tokens.

items.title: CF Benchmarks brings Wall Street pricing infrastructure onchain, including data used by BlackRock
items.summary: The new service could help developers build blockchain-based index funds, tokenized portfolios and derivatives using established financial benchmarks.
